'''Shiv''' is an [[Andoran]] soldier under the command of [[Jarid Sarand]] and acts as a scout. 

==Activities==
Jarid's force is on the road to [[Whitebridge]] when it is hit by a [[bubble of evil]] that turns all metal soft. Troubled by Jarid's increasing fervor to try and kill [[Elayne Trakand]], Shiv and the rest of the men abandon Jarid and march for the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].

== Trivia ==
* Shiv is named for Shiv Whorra, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
